fusions.name: Running Fire
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of arcana that deals 7 damage. Your movement speed rises 10% for 3 seconds after you use it. Holds up to 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Rear and Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks a short cone of force 3 tiles ahead that deals 13 damage, knocks everything caught back 3 tiles, and has a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Untiring Cadence
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 25% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Long Haul
fusions.desc: When your mana runs dry, you regain 3 mana a second for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
